metadata.description: TALXIS plugins for coding agents — build Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo with the TALXIS CLI (txc): scaffold, build, validate, and deploy deterministically.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: Build TALXIS / Power Platform apps in a local-first monorepo: scaffold components with the TALXIS CLI (txc), validate with dotnet build, deploy as Package Deployer packages. Use when creating a new TALXIS project or working on an existing one.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design-phase skills for TALXIS / Power Platform / Dataverse projects: reuse-first prototyping that models screens and custom UI components from proven industry patterns, existing TALXIS assets and the base-controls library, and turns user-story acceptance criteria into executable Gherkin feature files in a companion tests repo. Use when prototyping a screen or a custom control before implementation starts, or when authoring BDD tests from acceptance criteria and gating readiness on coverage. Produces design artifacts only — scaffolding, building, or running anything in the app workspace belongs to the implement plugin.
